header.title: Source of Funds
header.description: Pick the purpose first, then review the evidence path.

planned.title: Planned exchange sale
planned.body: Prepare a bank or exchange disclosure before the deposit or sale happens.

existing.title: Already happened
existing.body: Explain a completed sale, exchange deposit, withdrawal, or transfer.

purpose.plannedHint: Planned reports prove the reviewed history of the bitcoin you intend to sell. If those sats were originally bought on an exchange, attach fiat-funds proof to that purchase source as a separate evidence item.

bankNote.label: Bank disclosure note
bankNote.placeholder: Expected EUR proceeds, bank contact, or internal case note

actionsBar.assembleHint: Kassiber assembles every hop it can prove from local evidence: transaction inputs/outputs of synced wallets (Bitcoin and Liquid), Lightning payment hashes, platform ids, and reviewed pairs. The more wallets and connections this book has, the more complete the assembled flow. You document only what remains.
actionsBar.manualReviewHint_one: {{count}} weak or chain-observation suggestion still needs manual review.
actionsBar.manualReviewHint_other: {{count}} weak or chain-observation suggestions still need manual review.

gapDefaults.label: Reviewed missing history
gapDefaults.description: Prior history is missing and has been reviewed as a disclosure gap.

export.intro: Review what the report will expose before exporting. Export is available only when all blockers are cleared, and the PDF includes reviewed evidence only.

exportStage.title: Freeze and hand over
exportStage.lede: Export renders from a saved immutable case snapshot. Live edits never change a handed-over dossier, and later re-renders use the same reviewed case data even though generated file metadata may differ.

reviewQueue.title: Review Queue
reviewQueue.description: Matched links for the selected target, plus suggested upstream hops that can extend the path.
reviewQueue.empty: No matched links yet. Kassiber will look for same-id transfers, reviewed pairs, provider ids, and tight amount/time hints.

linkReview.title: Link Review
linkReview.description: Accept, reject, allocate, and attach evidence.

sourceOrGap.title: Source Or Gap
sourceOrGap.description: Add a reviewed root source or explicit missing-history stop.
sourceOrGap.label: Label

manualLink.title: Manual Link
manualLink.description: Connect two known transactions with explicit allocation.

gates.title: Gates
gates.previewUnavailable: No source-funds report can be built for this target yet.

disclosure.title: Disclosure
disclosure.narrative: This {{purpose}} will disclose the reviewed flow for {{target}}. It will expose {{txids}}, {{evidence}}, {{links}}, and {{sources}}.
disclosure.noPreview: No disclosure preview is available yet.
disclosure.walletPrivacyNote: Kassiber does not include descriptors, xpubs, wallet files, seeds, backend tokens, or unrelated wallet history in the PDF.

caseBrief.noPreview: Local case data is not available yet.

coverage.summary: {{amount}} BTC fully traced across {{count}} inbound transactions
coverage.noInbound: No inbound transactions in this profile yet.
coverage.truncated: Coverage truncated to {{shown}} of {{total}} inbound transactions ({{notClassified}} not classified). Run <0>source-funds coverage</0> with a higher --max-transactions to compute the full set.

recipient.empty: No recipients defined yet. Run <0>source-funds recipients create</0> to set a sticky reveal-mode default per recipient.
recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.hint: The recipient's preferred reveal mode is shown as advisory below; your reveal-mode choice is what gets exported.
recipient.advisory: {{label}} prefers <0>{{preferred}}</0>. Your current reveal mode is <1>{{current}}</1>.

toast.manualLinkBody: The reviewed flow has been updated.
toast.sourcePathBody: The source-funds path has been updated.

case.description: Explain the origin of one amount using the evidence in this book.
case.scopeError: The active book could not be identified. Please try again.
case.assistantPrompt: Investigate the source of funds for transaction {{target}} using ui.source_funds.review_context with this exact recipe: {{recipe}}. Explain what the current evidence proves and what remains missing. Use the source-funds input handoff when a connection, history import or attachment is needed. Preview proposed changes before asking for approval; do not treat a documented gap as proof.
case.selectTarget: Select a transaction and the amount to explain.
case.needsEvidence: Further evidence or review is needed.
case.exportable: The current report passes the export checks.
case.reviewUnavailable: The current evidence path could not be loaded.
case.targetUnavailable: This transaction could not be resolved in the active book. Select a transaction or enter its exact reference.
case.noBlockers: No open findings in the current report. Export availability is checked separately.
case.exportBlocked: The current report does not pass the export checks.
case.attested: Prior-history attestation ({{percent}}%) is shown separately and does not count as fully traced.
case.optionalRecipient: No recipient selected. A recipient is optional; the disclosure settings below determine the report contents.
case.scopeTruncated: This investigation reached its evidence limit. The displayed list is partial; missing rows are not proof of a complete path.
case.exportError: The export did not complete. Review the current case and try again.
case.exportFingerprintChanged: The case changed. Inspect it again before exporting.
case.optionalAmount: Leave blank to explain the full transaction amount.

workstation.frozenIntoTheCaseAt: Frozen into the case at export time.
workstation.goToTheTraceWork: Go to the trace work ledger to resolve them →
workstation.localPreviewDataIsNot: Local preview data is not available yet.
workstation.maskRecipientNameOnThe: Mask recipient name on the cover
workstation.everyDossierIsAnchoredTo: Every dossier is anchored to one transaction. Kassiber traces history backwards from it and disclosure stays scoped to the amount you enter — nothing else.
workstation.everythingBelowIsExactlyWhat: Review the disclosure before export. Choose its scope, hide individual transactions and adjust report sections for the recipient.
workstation.kassiberProvesEveryHopIt: Kassiber examines existing wallet observations, payment hashes and reviewed links. Suggestions remain distinct from verified evidence.
workstation.level1IsTheReport: Level 1 is the report target; each further level moves one reviewed hop backwards towards the root sources. This is the granular table the exported PDF renders.
workstation.noMatchedLinksYetAssemble: No matched links yet. Assemble History looks for transaction input/output structure, payment hashes, same-id transfers, reviewed pairs, and provider ids.
workstation.overrideTheRevealModeFor: Override the reveal mode for individual transactions. Changes update the preview live and freeze into the exported case.
workstation.renderedOnThisDeviceIdentical: Locally rendered preview of the report diagrams.
workstation.reportPdfPlusTheOriginal: Report PDF plus the original evidence files and a SHA-256 manifest, reveal-mode scoped.
workstation.saveAFrozenCaseAnd: Save a frozen case and export the recipient handoff ZIP from the same reviewed snapshot:
workstation.savesTheCaseSnapshotFirst: Saves the case snapshot first, then renders the PDF from it.
workstation.whoReceivesThisDossierTheir: Who receives this dossier — their default reveal mode is a suggestion, your choice wins.

path_truncated.title: Path truncated
path_truncated.nextStep: Resolve the upstream path or attest a missing-history stop

messages.source-fundsGraphExceededThePerreportNod: Source-funds graph exceeded the per-report node/edge cap; review the upstream suggestions or split the disclosure into a narrower target before retrying.

missing_history.title: Missing history
missing_history.nextStep: Attach a root source or attest the gap

messages.referencedTransactionIsNoLongerPresent: Referenced transaction is no longer present.
messages.thePathStopsAtATransactionWithout: The path stops at a transaction without a reviewed root source or missing-history attestation.
messages.reviewedMissinghistoryGapIncludedItIsNot: Reviewed missing-history gap included; it is not a real root source.

missing_pricing.nextStep: Add a fiat price for this transaction

messages.aTransactionOnTheDisclosedPathHas: A transaction on the disclosed path has no fiat pricing.

asset_mismatch.title: Asset mismatch
asset_mismatch.nextStep: Re-review the link with matching assets

messages.aRepeatedUpstreamTransactionIsRequiredWi: A repeated upstream transaction is required with conflicting assets.

transaction_overallocation.title: Transaction overallocated
transaction_overallocation.nextStep: Reduce the link allocation to the parent transaction amount

messages.aReviewedPathRequiresMoreValueThan: A reviewed path requires more value than this transaction holds.

unreviewed_link.title: Link awaiting review
unreviewed_link.nextStep: Review the suggested link or reject it

messages.aSuggestedSourcefundsLinkStillNeedsRevie: A suggested source-funds link still needs review before export.

ambiguous_allocation.title: Ambiguous allocation
ambiguous_allocation.nextStep: Set an explicit allocation amount and policy on the link

messages.reviewedAllocationsDoNotExactlyCoverThe: Reviewed allocations do not exactly cover the required amount.
messages.aReviewedLinkIsMissingAnExplicit: A reviewed link is missing an explicit allocation amount.
messages.aReviewedLinkStillUsesAHeuristic: A reviewed link still uses a heuristic or unknown allocation policy.
messages.aRepeatedUpstreamTransactionReceivedAddi: A repeated upstream transaction received additional required amount after it was reviewed.

unconfirmed_chain_data.title: Unconfirmed blockchain data
unconfirmed_chain_data.nextStep: Confirm or remove the chain observation backing this link

messages.unconfirmedChainObservationsCannotBeUsed: Unconfirmed chain observations cannot be used as proof in a PDF export.

chain_observation_privacy.title: Blockchain observation
chain_observation_privacy.nextStep: Chain-only evidence is context, not proof: add primary evidence

messages.chain-backendObservationsAreContextOnlyA: Chain-backend observations are context only and do not prove ownership.

privacy_hop_unresolved.title: Privacy transition unresolved
privacy_hop_unresolved.nextStep: Attach explicit evidence covering the privacy hop

messages.privacy-hopLinksRequireExplicitSupportin: Privacy-hop links require explicit supporting evidence; unrelated participant inputs are not shown.

stale_custody_component_lineage.title: Custody evidence changed
stale_custody_component_lineage.nextStep: Open the relevant link or source to resolve this finding

messages.aReviewedCustodyLinkIsAbsentOr: A reviewed custody link is absent or stale in the current stored projection.

source_asset_mismatch.title: Source asset mismatch
source_asset_mismatch.nextStep: Pick a source whose asset matches the link

messages.aReviewedLinkAllocatesADifferentAsset: A reviewed link allocates a different asset than its source record.

chronology_violation.title: Chronology conflict
chronology_violation.nextStep: Pick a parent dated on or before the child transaction

messages.aReviewedSourceIsDatedAfterThe: A reviewed source is dated after the transaction it funds.
messages.aReviewedParentTransactionOccursAfterThe: A reviewed parent transaction occurs after the child transaction it funds.

path_cycle.title: Cycle in path
path_cycle.nextStep: Break the cycle by removing one of the reviewed links

messages.aReviewedSourcefundsPathFormsACycle: A reviewed source-funds path forms a cycle.

source_amount_missing.title: Source amount missing
source_amount_missing.nextStep: Set the source's amount before exporting

messages.aConcreteSourceRecordNeedsAnAmount: A concrete source record needs an amount before it can support export.

source_overallocation.title: Source overallocated
source_overallocation.nextStep: Reduce link allocations or split across multiple sources

messages.reviewedLinksAllocateMoreFundsThanThe: Reviewed links allocate more funds than the source record contains.
